title: BurgerIndex
description: The single dataset the Python pipeline writes to data/burger_index.json and the Next.js site reads at build time. It carries only what the site reads. Prices are USD. Keep this file, pipeline/models.py and web/src/lib/schema.ts in sync.

restaurants_priced.description: Restaurant locations with an index_price (each chain location counts here).

index_median.description: THE Burger Index: median index_price across distinct menus — each independent restaurant once, each chain once however many locations it has.

AreaSummary.description: A borough or a neighborhood with at least one restaurant in the dataset, priced or not.

restaurants_priced.description: Priced restaurant locations in the area (each chain location counts).

index_median.description: Median index_price over distinct menus in the area: a chain counts at most once per area.

Burger.description: A priced restaurant's one burger: its highest-priced eligible beef burger (one burger for one person; no group platter, combo, eating challenge or kids' item; a Deluxe or with-fries version gives way to the cheaper plain burger on the same menu; dinner or all-day price first; never happy hour). Its price is the restaurant's index_price.

HandCheck.description: A person re-read the live menu and corrected the scraped prices (pipeline/data/corrections.json).

Restaurant.description: One restaurant location: a PricedRestaurant when index_price is a number, an UnpricedRestaurant when it is null.

PricedRestaurant.description: A restaurant with an index price: it gets a page on the site.

id.description: URL slug, unique and permanent (People's Price answers are keyed on it). Name + neighborhood (+ short DOHMH id suffix on collision), assigned over every restaurant in scope.

name.description: Display name in normal case (not the DOHMH all-caps dba).

chain.description: Chain brand slug when this location shares a chain-level menu scrape (e.g. '7th-street-burger').

menu_url.description: The page the prices were read from.

price_source.description: delivery_app prices usually run above in-store prices; the site labels them.

index_price.description: The price of the restaurant's burger.

hand_check.description: Set when a hand correction (not a withhold) from pipeline/data/corrections.json applies to this restaurant's menu and it stays priced; the published burger or price may be unchanged. Null otherwise.

UnpricedRestaurant.description: A restaurant in scope without an index price (no menu found, no beef burger, no price online, a withheld price). It has no page: the site lists its name on its neighborhood's page.

id.description: Assigned like a PricedRestaurant's, so it stays the same once the restaurant is priced.
